{"context_blocks":[{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00077_8c5974abdb87","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"text":"# III. Initial Caps: Defined Terms
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00079_29ffc3ba5a1b","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"text":"## 1. Rule
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00097_ab5dd89ccfaf","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"text":"## 2. Initial Caps are not emphasis
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00103_6da957b96545","block_type":"code_fence","status_markers":[],"text":"```text
The party crosses the road during heavy rain.
A familiar route may still become dangerous.
The Colony records the event in its Chronicle.
```
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00107_9d5e6ce72543","block_type":"code_fence","status_markers":[],"text":"```text
The Party crosses the Road during Heavy Rain.
A Familiar Route may still become Dangerous.
```
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00109_6efa29db2d8d","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"text":"## 3. Defined and ordinary senses may coexist
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00111_517df41e2738","block_type":"code_fence","status_markers":[],"text":"```text
A Place is a formal Colony category.
This is a quiet place beside the wall.
```
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00113_1335d97fe53f","block_type":"code_fence","status_markers":[],"text":"```text
Home is the permanent founding sanctuary.
The Citizen comes home before Night.
```
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00117_7c18b959d202","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"text":"## 4. Multiword Defined Terms
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00127_06d479f79bb3","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"text":"# IV. Experiential Operators in ALL CAPS
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00129_c63a23c0a44b","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"text":"## 1. Register operators
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00139_5d7871da27cc","block_type":"code_fence","status_markers":[],"text":"```text
Crossing is the Register. The player acts through RISK.
Field carries the party through territory by means of TRAVEL.
```
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00143_1add19916306","block_type":"code_fence","status_markers":[],"text":"```text
RISK is the Register.
Away.RISK.Crossing
Architecture.Register.Risk
```
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00145_9667fc098783","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"text":"## 2. Core-Species spatial operators
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00153_d2a206324a85","block_type":"code_fence","status_markers":[],"text":"```text
Mouse uses JOIN to extend protected continuity.
A new Rabbit Court must GATHER around shared ground.
Squirrel uses CONNECT to bring a separated Place into the Web.
```
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00155_c4c73d881d28","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"text":"## 3. Ordinary verbs remain ordinary
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00159_69a3706da809","block_type":"code_fence","status_markers":[],"text":"```text
The player observes the road, chooses a line, commits, and begins the Continuous Run.
```
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00163_9cc7024d0e76","block_type":"code_fence","status_markers":[],"text":"```text
The player OBSERVES, CHOOSES, COMMITS, and BEGINS.
```
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00167_4eeb82c0282b","block_type":"heading","status_markers":[],"text":"## 4. No all-caps emphasis
"}],"ordinal_range":[77,170],"pilot_id":"M050-AUTHGRAM-PILOT-001-R5","schema_version":"M050-PILOT-PAYLOAD-0.2","source_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001","source_sha256":"7d23ef2ccbff0c6594975c03cf405d838a3cc3f712ea6faf942581a72c9284ff","target_blocks":[{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00081_471dd5588948","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"A noun or noun phrase receives **Initial Caps** when MEDIAN gives it a stable, defined game meaning that differs from, narrows, or formalizes ordinary English usage.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00083_1a3fe43e01bb","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"Examples:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00085_89c840d34203","block_type":"code_fence","status_markers":[],"text":"```text
Citizen
Colony
Place
Practice
Project
Role
Mode
Register
View
Body Unit
Exposure
Quiet Equilibrium
Chronicle
Almanac
Home
Away
```
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00087_25f6b2e32ce1","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"The governing test is not:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00089_e9c48c5dbde2","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"> Is this noun important?
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00091_cefc5e71a60e","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"The governing test is:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00093_d17c8c408b1d","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"> Could this term receive a definition, MSID, glossary entry, stable cross-document reference, or explicit owner?
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00095_5c7fe3f5cb04","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"If yes, Initial Caps may be warranted.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00099_3c3157b6b149","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"Do not capitalize ordinary prose merely to make it feel weighty.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00101_3623714e4182","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"Prefer:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00105_6cb1009833c7","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"Not:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00115_99783b6a1d06","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"Where ambiguity is likely, rewrite rather than relying on capitalization alone.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00119_052480e51c64","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"Capitalize the significant elements of a Defined Term:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00121_56839f09cc53","block_type":"code_fence","status_markers":[],"text":"```text
Body Unit
Quiet Equilibrium
Continuous Run
Community Board
Gathering Place
Prior-life Tale
```
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00123_4e30e0ba3f70","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"Articles, conjunctions, and internal prepositions remain lowercase unless the canonical term begins with them.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00131_58e32cffd92c","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"The five canonical experiential operators are:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00133_6414bad8a1ba","block_type":"code_fence","status_markers":[],"text":"```text
Colony       : DWELL
Field        : TRAVEL
Crossing     : RISK
Encounter    : MEET
Embodiment   : EMBODY
```
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00135_b9381866d787","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"ALL CAPS identifies the operator through which the player acts. It does not replace the Register noun.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00137_b828cc3afe74","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"Correct:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00141_99adcd013e48","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"Incorrect:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00147_31327bcbabf7","block_type":"code_fence","status_markers":[],"text":"```text
Mouse        : JOIN
Rabbit       : GATHER
Squirrel     : CONNECT
```
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00149_9f461f36e392","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"These are canonical spatial and civilizational operators, not general-purpose emphatic verbs.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00151_b828cc3afe74","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"Correct:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00157_4848b16de1ab","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"Do not capitalize every player action.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00161_6cb1009833c7","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"Not:
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00165_6a674b106ea2","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"ALL CAPS is reserved for the canonical operator inventory.
"},{"block_id":"M050-SRC-AUTHORIAL-GRAMMAR-001__B00169_250d63a1b2cb","block_type":"paragraph","status_markers":[],"text":"Specification prose should not use all caps merely to shout or intensify. Use structure, syntax, bold text, or a defined callout class instead.
"}]}
END_SOURCE_BLOCKS
